ai_requirements.text: Status explanations must be accurate and must never invent a delivery date.

use_cases.name: Plain-language delivery status
use_cases.retrieval_notes: Retrieves the shipment's own status history only.
use_cases.orchestration: One synchronous call per request, no agent loop.
use_cases.prompt_and_structured_output: A fixed prompt returns a short structured answer.
use_cases.evaluation: A labelled set of status histories is scored weekly.
use_cases.responsible_ai_safety: The answer is restricted to the retrieved status history.
use_cases.monitoring_feedback: Users can flag a wrong explanation.
use_cases.data_privacy: Only shipment data is sent; no customer identity leaves the platform.

mandatory_human_decisions.text: A disputed delivery is decided by a person.

architecture_pattern: Retrieval-augmented generation over the shipment status store.

provider_options.rationale: Keeps data in the selected platform.

framework_recommendations.validation_reason: A recommendation, not a customer requirement.
framework_recommendations.name: LangChain
framework_recommendations.rationale: The team needs structured answers validated before they reach the portal.
